answer.answer: Current: Beginning in 2026, Elm API requires OAuth 2.1 and no longer accepts API keys (elm-auth-2026). This is the latest supplied snapshot, so OAuth 2.1 is the current required authentication mode as of the most recent evidence available. Previously valid: In 2025, Elm API required API keys (elm-auth-2025); that requirement was valid before the 2026 change and has been superseded. Both snapshots describe the same subject (subject_id elm-api, lineage_id elm-auth), so the 2026 snapshot supersedes the 2025 snapshot rather than describing a different subject. Unresolved: the exact effective date within 2026, any migration or grace-period arrangements for existing API keys, OAuth 2.1 implementation details, and whether OAuth 2.1 remains required beyond 2026 are not addressed by the supplied sources.
